fruits.extendedStory: Building started in 1425, on the market square at the heart of the town. Matheus de Layens carried the work on in Gothic, the style of high windows and pointed arches. The church takes its name from Saint Peter. When the old wall was drawn, this church sat at the centre of the circle. Everything else in the Old Town grew around it.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Bau begann 1425, am Marktplatz mitten in der Stadt. Matheus de Layens führte ihn weiter in gotischer Architektur, dem Stil der hohen Fenster und Spitzbögen. Ihren Namen hat die Kirche von Petrus. Als man die alte Mauer zog, lag diese Kirche im Mittelpunkt des Kreises. Alles andere in der Altstadt wuchs um sie herum.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Building started in 1425, on the market square at the heart of the town. Matheus de Layens carried the work on in Gothic, the style of high windows and pointed arches. The church takes its name from Saint Peter. When the old wall was drawn, this church sat at the centre of the circle. Everything else in the Old Town grew around it.

localizedStory.de: Die Kirche, um die herum die Altstadt entstand. Matheus de Layens baute weiter an ihr, begonnen 1425.
localizedStory.en: The church the Old Town was drawn around. Matheus de Layens carried on its building, begun in 1425.

fruits.story: The church the Old Town was drawn around. Matheus de Layens carried on its building, begun in 1425.

fruits.extendedStory: Work began in 1439 and the doors did not open until 1469. Three decades of masons went into one building on one square. Sulpitius van Vorst designed it in Brabantine Gothic, the style Brabant made its own. That style loves height and fine stone detail, and the front carries both. Leuven still calls it the Stadhuis, and it is still the town hall.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Bau begann 1439, fertig war das Haus 1469. Drei Jahrzehnte lang arbeiteten Steinmetze an diesem Haus an diesem Platz. Sulpitius van Vorst entwarf es in Brabanter Gotik, dem Stil der Region. Dieser Stil liebt Höhe und feine Steinarbeit, beides zeigt die Fassade. Leuven nennt es bis heute Stadhuis, und es ist bis heute das Rathaus.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Work began in 1439 and the doors did not open until 1469. Three decades of masons went into one building on one square. Sulpitius van Vorst designed it in Brabantine Gothic, the style Brabant made its own. That style loves height and fine stone detail, and the front carries both. Leuven still calls it the Stadhuis, and it is still the town hall.

localizedStory.de: Dreißig Jahre dauerte das Rathaus von Leuven. Sulpitius van Vorst begann 1439, 1469 war es fertig, in Brabanter Gotik.
localizedStory.en: Leuven's town hall took thirty years. Sulpitius van Vorst began it in 1439 and it opened in 1469, in Brabantine Gothic.

fruits.name: Stadhuis van Leuven
fruits.story: Leuven's town hall took thirty years. Sulpitius van Vorst began it in 1439 and it opened in 1469, in Brabantine Gothic.

fruits.extendedStory: In August 1914 German soldiers set fire to the university hall, and the old library burned with it. Whitney Warren designed the replacement, the same architect behind Grand Central Terminal in New York. It opened on 4 July 1928, American Independence Day. American engineering societies gave the carillon its forty-eight bells, as many as there were American states. The brick shaft below them is 48 metres tall.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Im August 1914 setzten deutsche Soldaten die Universitätshalle in Brand, die alte Bibliothek verbrannte mit. Whitney Warren entwarf den Neubau, derselbe Architekt wie beim Grand Central Terminal in New York. Eingeweiht wurde er am 4. Juli 1928, dem amerikanischen Unabhängigkeitstag. Amerikanische Ingenieurverbände schenkten das Glockenspiel mit achtundvierzig Glocken, so viele wie es damals US-Staaten gab. Der Backsteinschaft darunter misst 48 Meter.
localizedExtendedStory.en: In August 1914 German soldiers set fire to the university hall, and the old library burned with it. Whitney Warren designed the replacement, the same architect behind Grand Central Terminal in New York. It opened on 4 July 1928, American Independence Day. American engineering societies gave the carillon its forty-eight bells, as many as there were American states. The brick shaft below them is 48 metres tall.

localizedStory.de: Die alte Bibliothek brannte 1914. Der neue Turm ruht auf einem Backsteinschaft von 48 Metern und trägt achtundvierzig Glocken.
localizedStory.en: The old library burned in 1914. The tower that replaced it stands on a brick shaft of 48 metres, hung with forty-eight bells.

fruits.extendedStory: A city museum has stood on this spot since 1920, when the Stedelijk Museum Vander Kelen-Mertens opened. In 2009 it was rebuilt and renamed, and on 20 September that year it opened again as M. Stéphane Beel designed the new building. One letter, one museum, nearly ninety years after the doors here opened for the very beginning.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Seit 1920 steht an dieser Stelle ein Stadtmuseum, damals als Stedelijk Museum Vander Kelen-Mertens. 2009 wurde es umgebaut und umbenannt, und am 20. September jenes Jahres öffnete es wieder als M. Stéphane Beel entwarf den Neubau. Ein Buchstabe, ein Museum, fast neunzig Jahre nachdem sich die Türen hier zum Anfang öffneten.
localizedExtendedStory.en: A city museum has stood on this spot since 1920, when the Stedelijk Museum Vander Kelen-Mertens opened. In 2009 it was rebuilt and renamed, and on 20 September that year it opened again as M. Stéphane Beel designed the new building. One letter, one museum, nearly ninety years after the doors here opened for the very beginning.

localizedStory.de: Das Stadtmuseum wuchs aus dem alten Stedelijk Museum Vander Kelen-Mertens. Stéphane Beel gab ihm 2009 ein neues Haus.
localizedStory.en: Leuven's city museum grew out of the old Stedelijk Museum Vander Kelen-Mertens. Stéphane Beel gave it a new home in 2009.

fruits.extendedStory: A chapel stood here in the 12th century, and Duke Henry I turned it into a priory in 1206. In 1453 the west tower was crowned with an openwork spire to Jan van Ruysbroeck's design. Openwork means the stone is pierced, so you can see sky straight through it. On the night of 11 to 12 May 1944 a stray Allied bomb struck the church and the abbey buildings. It was one of its own side's bombs, dropped off target.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Im 12. Jahrhundert stand hier eine Kapelle, und 1206 machte Herzog Heinrich I. ein Priorat daraus. 1453 bekam der Westturm einen durchbrochenen Helm nach dem Entwurf von Jan van Ruysbroeck. Durchbrochen heißt, der Stein ist durchlöchert, man sieht den Himmel hindurch. In der Nacht vom 11. auf den 12. Mai 1944 traf eine verirrte alliierte Bombe Kirche und Abteigebäude. Es war eine Bombe der eigenen Seite, die ihr Ziel verfehlte.
localizedExtendedStory.en: A chapel stood here in the 12th century, and Duke Henry I turned it into a priory in 1206. In 1453 the west tower was crowned with an openwork spire to Jan van Ruysbroeck's design. Openwork means the stone is pierced, so you can see sky straight through it. On the night of 11 to 12 May 1944 a stray Allied bomb struck the church and the abbey buildings. It was one of its own side's bombs, dropped off target.

localizedStory.de: Herzog Heinrich I. machte hier 1206 aus einer Kapelle ein Priorat. Der durchbrochene Turmhelm kam 1453 dazu.
localizedStory.en: Duke Henry I turned a chapel here into a priory in 1206. Its openwork spire went up in 1453.

fruits.extendedStory: The begijnhof around it was a walled village inside the town. Women lived here in a religious community without taking the vows of a nun. Their church was begun in 1305 and carries the name of John the Baptist. Gothic builders gave it pointed arches and tall windows, the shapes that pull your eye upward. The lanes here still run as they did, quiet and free of cars.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Beginenhof ringsum war ein ummauertes Dorf mitten in der Stadt. Hier lebten Frauen in einer frommen Gemeinschaft, ohne Ordensgelübde abzulegen. Ihre Kirche wurde 1305 begonnen und trägt den Namen von Johannes dem Täufer. Gotische Baumeister gaben ihr Spitzbögen und hohe Fenster, Formen, die den Blick nach oben ziehen. Die Gassen verlaufen noch wie damals, still und ohne Autos.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The begijnhof around it was a walled village inside the town. Women lived here in a religious community without taking the vows of a nun. Their church was begun in 1305 and carries the name of John the Baptist. Gothic builders gave it pointed arches and tall windows, the shapes that pull your eye upward. The lanes here still run as they did, quiet and free of cars.

localizedStory.de: Die Kirche des Beginenhofs, begonnen 1305 und Johannes dem Täufer geweiht.
localizedStory.en: The church of the begijnhof, begun in 1305 and named for John the Baptist.

fruits.name: Sint-Jan de Doperkerk
fruits.story: The church of the begijnhof, begun in 1305 and named for John the Baptist.

fruits.extendedStory: The ring ran about 2700 metres, a near circle with Sint-Pieterskerk at its heart. Eleven stone gates let the main roads through, and thirty-one towers watched the gaps. Duke Henry I of Brabant probably ordered it built. Books long dated the wall to 1156 to 1165, but its arrow slits say early 13th century. Seventy metres still stand in the Handbooghof, two towers included.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Ring maß rund 2700 Meter, fast ein Kreis mit der Sint-Pieterskerk in der Mitte. Elf steinerne Tore ließen die Hauptstraßen durch, einunddreißig Türme bewachten die Lücken. Herzog Heinrich I. von Brabant gab wohl den Bau in Auftrag. Lange galt 1156 bis 1165 als Bauzeit, doch die Schießscharten deuten auf das frühe 13. Jahrhundert. Siebzig Meter stehen noch im Handbooghof, samt zwei Türmen.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The ring ran about 2700 metres, a near circle with Sint-Pieterskerk at its heart. Eleven stone gates let the main roads through, and thirty-one towers watched the gaps. Duke Henry I of Brabant probably ordered it built. Books long dated the wall to 1156 to 1165, but its arrow slits say early 13th century. Seventy metres still stand in the Handbooghof, two towers included.

localizedStory.de: Leuven trug einst einen steinernen Ring von rund 2700 m Länge mit einunddreißig Türmen. In der Mitte stand die Sint-Pieterskerk.
localizedStory.en: Leuven once wore a stone ring about 2700 m long, with thirty-one towers. Sint-Pieterskerk stood at its centre.

fruits.story: Leuven once wore a stone ring about 2700 m long, with thirty-one towers. Sint-Pieterskerk stood at its centre.

fruits.extendedStory: The chapel on the square was begun in 1617, a date archive papers still carry. Three centuries later it took on a second life. In 1936 Father Damien was brought to Leuven and laid to rest here. The Leuven architect Victor Broos designed the mausoleum that holds him. The square has carried the name of Damian de Veuster ever since.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Die Kapelle am Platz wurde 1617 begonnen, ein Datum, das die Archivpapiere bis heute nennen. Drei Jahrhunderte später bekam sie eine zweite Aufgabe. 1936 brachte man Pater Damian nach Leuven und bettete ihn hier zur Ruhe. Der Leuvener Architekt Victor Broos entwarf das Mausoleum, das ihn birgt. Seither trägt der Platz den Namen von Damian de Veuster.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The chapel on the square was begun in 1617, a date archive papers still carry. Three centuries later it took on a second life. In 1936 Father Damien was brought to Leuven and laid to rest here. The Leuven architect Victor Broos designed the mausoleum that holds him. The square has carried the name of Damian de Veuster ever since.

localizedStory.de: Pater Damian de Veuster gab dem Platz seinen Namen. Seit 1936 ruht er in der Kapelle an diesem Platz.
localizedStory.en: Father Damien gave this square its name. The chapel on it has been his resting place since 1936.

fruits.name: Pater Damiaanplein
fruits.story: Father Damien gave this square its name. The chapel on it has been his resting place since 1936.

fruits.extendedStory: Ief Spincemaille was Leuven's city artist when he made this. It is built from 40 tonnes of undisturbed soil, ground that had never been dug. The work is called De Eerste Verstoring. It stands 5.30 metres high and was unveiled on 27 September 2014. Around it stand towers of the old city wall, built of stone and many centuries older.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Ief Spincemaille war Stadtkünstler von Leuven, als er diesen Turm baute. Er besteht aus 40 Tonnen unberührter Erde, Boden, der nie umgegraben wurde. Das Werk heißt De Eerste Verstoring. Es ist 5,30 Meter hoch und wurde am 27. September 2014 eingeweiht. Ringsum stehen Türme der alten Stadtmauer, aus Stein und viele Jahrhunderte älter.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Ief Spincemaille was Leuven's city artist when he made this. It is built from 40 tonnes of undisturbed soil, ground that had never been dug. The work is called De Eerste Verstoring. It stands 5.30 metres high and was unveiled on 27 September 2014. Around it stand towers of the old city wall, built of stone and many centuries older.

localizedStory.de: Ein Turm aus gestampfter Erde, 5,30 Meter hoch, 2014 zwischen die mittelalterlichen Mauertürme am Handbooghof gesetzt.
localizedStory.en: A tower of packed earth, 5.30 metres high, raised in 2014 among the medieval wall towers of the Handbooghof.

fruits.extendedStory: Leuven's second city wall met the river here, and this sluice complex crowned its completion in 1365. Four arcades carry the works across the Dijle. A wall can stop people, but water needs a gate that opens and shuts. In 1559 a mill was raised on one of the arcades, and water wheels already hung in the arches. So the gate that guarded the town also drove a wheel.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Hier traf die zweite Stadtmauer auf den Fluss, und dieser Schleusenbau krönte 1365 ihre Vollendung. Vier Bögen tragen das Werk über die Dijle. Eine Mauer hält Menschen auf, doch Wasser braucht ein Tor, das sich öffnen und schließen lässt. 1559 entstand eine Mühle auf einem der Bögen, Wasserräder hingen da schon in den Arkaden. So bewachte das Tor die Stadt und trieb zugleich ein Rad an.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Leuven's second city wall met the river here, and this sluice complex crowned its completion in 1365. Four arcades carry the works across the Dijle. A wall can stop people, but water needs a gate that opens and shuts. In 1559 a mill was raised on one of the arcades, and water wheels already hung in the arches. So the gate that guarded the town also drove a wheel.

localizedStory.de: Ein Wassertor, kein Straßentor. 1365 ließ man die Dijle unter vier Bögen in die Stadt, bewacht von oben.
localizedStory.en: A water gate, not a road gate. In 1365 the Dijle was let into town under four arches, guarded from above.
